file:copilot/__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:copilot/__init__.py.summary: Package init that re-exports the public API classes (CopilotClient, ChatReply, Copilot, ClearanceRequired, BrowserCopilot, load_auth) from the copilot submodules.

file:copilot/auth.py.name: auth.py
file:copilot/auth.py.summary: Manages signed-in session caching for the pure-HTTP path, loading and refreshing cookies and MSAL access tokens from a browser profile or cached snapshot.

function:copilot/auth.py:load_auth.name: load_auth
function:copilot/auth.py:load_auth.summary: Returns signed-in cookies and access token from cache or by launching a headless/visible browser session to refresh them.

file:copilot/browser.py.name: browser.py
file:copilot/browser.py.summary: Drives Playwright for Copilot sign-in, Cloudflare Turnstile clearance, and chat token capture, enabling headless session refresh for the pure-HTTP driver.

class:copilot/browser.py:BrowserCopilot.name: BrowserCopilot
class:copilot/browser.py:BrowserCopilot.summary: Launches a persistent Playwright Chromium profile to handle interactive sign-in, headless chat token capture via WebSocket, and Cloudflare Turnstile bypass for the Copilot session.

file:examples/01_direct_chat.py.name: 01_direct_chat.py
file:examples/01_direct_chat.py.summary: Demonstrates the simplest in-process chat usage of CopilotClient with a single non-streaming reply.

file:examples/02_direct_conversation.py.name: 02_direct_conversation.py
file:examples/02_direct_conversation.py.summary: Demonstrates multi-turn conversation by reusing conversation_id to continue a Copilot chat session.

file:examples/03_direct_stream.py.name: 03_direct_stream.py
file:examples/03_direct_stream.py.summary: Demonstrates streaming Copilot chat responses incrementally as they are generated.

file:copilot/challenges.py.name: challenges.py
file:copilot/challenges.py.summary: Proof-of-work challenge solvers for Copilot's chat WebSocket, implementing hashcash and arithmetic copilot variants that mirror copilot.microsoft.com's own client.

function:copilot/challenges.py:_hashcash.name: _hashcash_ok
function:copilot/challenges.py:_hashcash.summary: Checks whether a SHA-256 digest has at least a given number of leading zero bits for hashcash proof-of-work validation.

function:copilot/challenges.py:solve_has.name: solve_hashcash
function:copilot/challenges.py:solve_has.summary: Solves a hashcash challenge by finding the smallest nonce whose SHA-256 digest has the required leading zero bits.

function:copilot/challenges.py:solve_cop.name: solve_copilot_challenge
function:copilot/challenges.py:solve_cop.summary: Solves the arithmetic copilot challenge by computing floor((a^3/100 + a*25) mod 22) rounded to nearest integer.

file:copilot/client.py.name: client.py
file:copilot/client.py.summary: High-level Copilot client providing chat and stream methods with transparent auth refresh, Cloudflare clearance recovery via browser, and anonymous mode support.

function:copilot/client.py:_status.name: _status
function:copilot/client.py:_status.summary: Emits a progress or recovery message to stderr so it never mixes into reply text on stdout.

class:copilot/client.py:ChatReply.name: ChatReply
class:copilot/client.py:ChatReply.summary: Dataclass holding the full result of a chat call, including text, conversation id, and any generated images.

class:copilot/client.py:ChatStream.name: ChatStream
class:copilot/client.py:ChatStream.summary: Iterable stream of reply chunks that also exposes the conversation id, yielding text and ImageResponse items.

class:copilot/client.py:CopilotClient.name: CopilotClient
class:copilot/client.py:CopilotClient.summary: Main Copilot client managing signed-in auth, Cloudflare clearance recovery, and chat/stream interactions across multiple conversations.

file:copilot/driver.py.name: driver.py
file:copilot/driver.py.summary: Pure-HTTP Copilot driver implementing Microsoft's consumer chat protocol over a Cloudflare-impersonating curl_cffi session with WebSocket streaming and in-process challenge solving.

class:copilot/driver.py:ClearanceRequire.name: ClearanceRequired
class:copilot/driver.py:ClearanceRequire.summary: Exception raised when the chat socket demands a Cloudflare Turnstile token that cannot be minted in a pure-HTTP session.

class:copilot/driver.py:Copilot.name: Copilot
class:copilot/driver.py:Copilot.summary: Concrete Copilot provider implementing chat protocol over curl_cffi with conversation creation, attachment upload, WebSocket handshake, and streaming response parsing.

file:copilot/models.py.name: models.py
file:copilot/models.py.summary: Shared data types including ImageResponse, AbstractProvider base class, and Conversation container used across both the pure-HTTP and browser driver paths.

class:copilot/models.py:ImageResponse.name: ImageResponse
class:copilot/models.py:ImageResponse.summary: Dataclass holding a generated image's URL, prompt, and associated metadata.

class:copilot/models.py:AbstractProvider.name: AbstractProvider
class:copilot/models.py:AbstractProvider.summary: Abstract base class defining the provider interface with label, url, streaming support, and an abstract create_completion method.

class:copilot/models.py:Conversation.name: Conversation
class:copilot/models.py:Conversation.summary: Thread-safe conversation container holding conversation id, cookie jar, access token, and providing cookie dictionary access.

file:copilot/protocol.py.name: protocol.py
file:copilot/protocol.py.summary: Shared Microsoft Copilot chat-protocol constants including WebSocket URL, setOptions handshake frame, and consents frame captured from a live session.

file:copilot/utils.py.name: utils.py
file:copilot/utils.py.summary: Low-level protocol and I/O helpers including HTTP status checking, WebSocket frame reassembly via JSON draining, and image encoding utilities.

function:copilot/utils.py:raise_for_stat.name: raise_for_status
function:copilot/utils.py:raise_for_stat.summary: Raises an exception if the HTTP response status code indicates a client or server error.

function:copilot/utils.py:drain_json.name: drain_json
function:copilot/utils.py:drain_json.summary: Greedily parses all complete JSON objects from a byte buffer, returning the parsed objects and any trailing partial data for reassembly.

function:copilot/utils.py:to_bytes.name: to_bytes
function:copilot/utils.py:to_bytes.summary: Converts an image file path or raw bytes into bytes for upload.

function:copilot/utils.py:is_accepted_fo.name: is_accepted_format
function:copilot/utils.py:is_accepted_fo.summary: Determines the MIME type of image data by checking magic bytes for PNG or JPEG, defaulting to octet-stream.

file:server/api.py.name: api.py
file:server/api.py.summary: FastAPI application entry point that wires Microsoft Copilot onto the OpenAI Chat Completions API, exposing endpoints for listing models and generating streaming/non-streaming chat completions.

file:server/config.py.name: config.py
file:server/config.py.summary: Server configuration constants for model name, rate limit RPM, and rate limit burst, sourced from environment variables with sensible defaults.

file:server/openai_format.py.name: openai_format.py
file:server/openai_format.py.summary: Builders for OpenAI wire-format objects including non-streaming completion responses, SSE event serialization, and streaming chunk objects.

file:server/prompt.py.name: prompt.py
file:server/prompt.py.summary: Flattens OpenAI message arrays into a single Copilot prompt string, handling system messages, multi-turn conversations, and content parts.

file:server/ratelimit.py.name: ratelimit.py
file:server/ratelimit.py.summary: Thread-safe token-bucket rate limiter providing a self-imposed per-minute ceiling on upstream requests, orthogonal to the concurrency lock in the API layer.

file:server/schemas.py.name: schemas.py
file:server/schemas.py.summary: Pydantic request models defining the OpenAI-compatible chat completion request shape with support for streaming, conversation threading, and content parts.

function:server/api.py:_rate_limited_res.name: _rate_limited_response
function:server/api.py:_rate_limited_res.summary: Spends a rate-limit token and returns an OpenAI-shaped 429 response if the bucket is empty, or None if the request is allowed.

function:server/api.py:_stream.name: _stream
function:server/api.py:_stream.summary: Generator that yields OpenAI chat.completion.chunk SSE events for a prompt, serializing upstream Copilot access with a threading lock and handling ClearanceRequired and other errors.

function:server/api.py:list_models.name: list_models
function:server/api.py:list_models.summary: GET /v1/models handler returning the single advertised Copilot model in OpenAI format.

function:server/api.py:get_model_id.name: get_model_id
function:server/api.py:get_model_id.summary: GET /v1/models/{model_id} handler returning a static model object for any requested model id.

function:server/api.py:list_api_models.name: list_api_models
function:server/api.py:list_api_models.summary: GET /api/v1/models handler returning the Copilot model in OpenAI format at a secondary path.

function:server/api.py:get_problems.name: get_problems
function:server/api.py:get_problems.summary: GET /v1/probs stub handler returning an empty problems list.

function:server/api.py:post_show.name: post_show
function:server/api.py:post_show.summary: POST /api/show stub handler returning an empty show response.

function:server/api.py:chat_completions.name: chat_completions
function:server/api.py:chat_completions.summary: POST /v1/chat/completions handler that validates the prompt, enforces rate limits, and dispatches streaming or non-streaming responses through the Copilot client.

function:server/api.py:get_version.name: get_version
function:server/api.py:get_version.summary: GET /version handler returning the API version string.

function:server/api.py:root.name: root
function:server/api.py:root.summary: GET / root handler returning the service name and list of available endpoints.

function:server/openai_format.py:new_id.name: new_id
function:server/openai_format.py:new_id.summary: Generates a fresh chatcmpl- UUID string matching the OpenAI chat completion ID format.

function:server/openai_format.py:complet.name: completion_response
function:server/openai_format.py:complet.summary: Builds an OpenAI non-streaming chat.completion response dict with the assistant message, model id, and optional Copilot conversation id.

function:server/openai_format.py:sse_eve.name: sse_event
function:server/openai_format.py:sse_eve.summary: Serializes a payload dict as a Server-Sent Events data: line.

function:server/openai_format.py:stream_.name: stream_chunk
function:server/openai_format.py:stream_.summary: Builds a single chat.completion.chunk dict for OpenAI streaming responses, including optional conversation id on the final chunk.

function:server/prompt.py:content_text.name: content_text
function:server/prompt.py:content_text.summary: Extracts plain text from a message content field, handling both plain strings and OpenAI content-parts arrays.

function:server/prompt.py:messages_to_pr.name: messages_to_prompt
function:server/prompt.py:messages_to_pr.summary: Flattens an OpenAI messages array into a single Copilot prompt string, handling system messages and multi-turn conversation formatting.

class:server/ratelimit.py:TokenBucket.name: TokenBucket
class:server/ratelimit.py:TokenBucket.summary: Thread-safe token-bucket rate limiter with configurable RPM and burst, injectable clock for testing, and non-blocking try_acquire interface.

class:server/schemas.py:ChatMessage.name: ChatMessage
class:server/schemas.py:ChatMessage.summary: Pydantic model representing a single chat message with role and optional content (plain string or content-parts).

class:server/schemas.py:ChatCompletionRe.name: ChatCompletionRequest
class:server/schemas.py:ChatCompletionRe.summary: Pydantic model for OpenAI-compatible chat completion requests with messages, model, stream flag, and optional Copilot conversation id.

file:reproduce_issue_loop.py.summary: Script that reproduces an asyncio nesting issue with Playwright's sync API by incorrectly wrapping synchronous Playwright code inside an async main function.

function:reproduce_issue_loop.py:main.summary: Async function that attempts to run Playwright's sync API inside an async context, causing an event loop nesting error.

file:reproduce_issue.py.summary: Demonstrates the fix for the async Playwright issue by applying nest_asyncio before using Playwright's sync API at module level.

file:tests/diagnostic.py.name: diagnostic.py
file:tests/diagnostic.py.summary: Diagnostic tool for debugging broken Copilot sessions — captures WebSocket protocol via a real browser, redacts secrets, snapshots fresh auth tokens, and writes a shareable HTML report.

function:tests/diagnostic.py:redact.name: redact
function:tests/diagnostic.py:redact.summary: Strips secrets (tokens, JWTs, auth codes, emails) from text using a cascade of regex patterns.

function:tests/diagnostic.py:_to_text.name: _to_text
function:tests/diagnostic.py:_to_text.summary: Converts payload (bytes or string) to a UTF-8 decoded string with replacement for invalid sequences.

function:tests/diagnostic.py:env_section.name: env_section
function:tests/diagnostic.py:env_section.summary: Writes Python version, platform, and machine info to the diagnostic report.

function:tests/diagnostic.py:packages_se.name: packages_section
function:tests/diagnostic.py:packages_se.summary: Reports installed versions of key packages (curl_cffi, playwright, fastapi, uvicorn, pydantic, websockets) for reproducibility.

function:tests/diagnostic.py:playwright_.name: playwright_section
function:tests/diagnostic.py:playwright_.summary: Verifies Playwright Chromium browser installation and reports its executable path.

function:tests/diagnostic.py:session_sec.name: session_section
function:tests/diagnostic.py:session_sec.summary: Reports session state including token presence, age, access_token length, and key cookie status without revealing secret values.

function:tests/diagnostic.py:_snapshot_a.name: _snapshot_auth
function:tests/diagnostic.py:_snapshot_a.summary: Captures a fresh token.json from the live browser context, reading cookies and MSAL token to avoid spawning a second browser.

function:tests/diagnostic.py:browser_cap.name: browser_capture
function:tests/diagnostic.py:browser_cap.summary: Opens a real browser with the signed-in profile, intercepts WebSocket chat frames (redacted) to ws_capture.log, and snapshots a fresh auth token after a completed turn.

function:tests/diagnostic.py:live_probe_.name: live_probe_section
function:tests/diagnostic.py:live_probe_.summary: Sends a real completion request via CopilotClient to test whether the saved session works, reporting success or failure with timing.

function:tests/diagnostic.py:log_tail_se.name: log_tail_section
function:tests/diagnostic.py:log_tail_se.summary: Appends the last N redacted lines of a log file to the diagnostic report.

function:tests/diagnostic.py:main.name: main
function:tests/diagnostic.py:main.summary: Orchestrates the full diagnostic: collects environment info, sessions, optionally runs the browser capture, performs a live probe, and writes the report.

class:tests/diagnostic.py:Report.name: Report
class:tests/diagnostic.py:Report.summary: Accumulates diagnostic report lines into a buffer while echoing them to the console, with section formatting helpers.

file:tests/gpqa_bench.py.name: gpqa_bench.py
file:tests/gpqa_bench.py.summary: GPQA accuracy benchmark that loads multiple-choice questions from a CSV, sends them to the OpenAI-compatible server, parses answers, and reports accuracy with optional JSON output.

function:tests/gpqa_bench.py:build_quest.name: build_question
function:tests/gpqa_bench.py:build_quest.summary: Shuffles answer options from a GPQA CSV row and builds a formatted prompt with the correct letter recorded.

function:tests/gpqa_bench.py:parse_lette.name: parse_letter
function:tests/gpqa_bench.py:parse_lette.summary: Extracts the chosen A-D letter from the model's free-text reply, preferring leading matches and falling back to any standalone letter.

function:tests/gpqa_bench.py:ask.name: ask
function:tests/gpqa_bench.py:ask.summary: Sends a chat completion request via urllib to the server endpoint and returns the reply text or error detail.

function:tests/gpqa_bench.py:main.name: main
function:tests/gpqa_bench.py:main.summary: Orchestrates the GPQA benchmark: parses CLI args, loads CSV, iterates questions with configurable delay, logs results, and optionally writes a JSON summary.

file:tests/ratelimit.py.name: ratelimit.py
file:tests/ratelimit.py.summary: Open-loop rate-limit probe that fires requests at a fixed wall-clock rate (RPM) using threaded workers, distinguishing bridge 429s from upstream 502s.

function:tests/ratelimit.py:classify.name: classify
function:tests/ratelimit.py:classify.summary: Sends one chat completion and classifies the result as ok, 429, 502, or other with elapsed time and detail.

function:tests/ratelimit.py:main.name: main
function:tests/ratelimit.py:main.summary: Orchestrates the open-loop rate-limit probe: parses args, schedules requests on timed slots via ThreadPoolExecutor, and summarizes category counts.

file:tests/stress.py.name: stress.py
file:tests/stress.py.summary: Concurrency stress test that doubles parallel request count each round, stopping at the first round with any failure to find the server's queue capacity ceiling.

function:tests/stress.py:one_request.name: one_request
function:tests/stress.py:one_request.summary: Sends a single chat completion and returns success status, elapsed time, and a detail string including error information.

function:tests/stress.py:run_round.name: run_round
function:tests/stress.py:run_round.summary: Fires a batch of concurrent requests via ThreadPoolExecutor and returns all results with wall-clock timing.

function:tests/stress.py:main.name: main
function:tests/stress.py:main.summary: Runs the stress test loop: doubles concurrency each round, reports latencies, stops on first failure, and prints the highest successful concurrency.
